title: 2013 HMMT November Team Problem 8
statement: Define the sequence \(\left\{x_{i}\right\}_{i \geq 0}\) by \(x_{0}=x_{1}=x_{2}=1\) and \(x_{k}=\frac{x_{k-1}+x_{k-2}+1}{x_{k-3}}\) for \(k>2\). Find \(x_{2013}\).

solutions.text: 9 We have \(x_{3}=\frac{1+1+1}{1}=3, x_{4}=\frac{3+1+1}{1}=5, x_{5}=\frac{5+3+1}{1}=9, x_{6}=\frac{9+5+1}{3}=5\). By the symmetry of our recurrence (or just further computation-it doesn't matter much), \(x_{7}=3\) and \(x_{8}=x_{9}=x_{10}=1\), so our sequence has period 8. Thus \(x_{2013}=x_{13}=x_{5}=9\).
